name: codex
description: Codex model stances and delegation discipline for testing frontier-model behavior across Sol, Terra, and supporting models.

interface.shortDescription: Model stances and delegation for Codex
interface.longDescription: Experiment with Sol-style delegation and A/B model stances in Codex. Use sol-delegate for a Sol main agent routing execution to Terra or other available models, and compare fable-mode with sol-mode on Terra or another Codex model.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex:sol-delegate to plan and route execution across Codex models.
Use $codex:fable-mode for the Fable-style A/B condition.
Use $codex:sol-mode for the Sol-style A/B condition.
